name: movie_delori_lpqi_filters
label: Movie: delta Ori Aa1 on the LPQI-Pathfinder with a different 1 nm filter each night (MPD), 20 nights
notes: Night j uses filter j mod 5: the same 330-530 m ground sweep samples the disk curve at pi theta B / lambda from the first lobe (H-alpha, null at 518 m) through the null (550, 500 nm) into the sidelobe (H-beta, 425 nm); the second panel plots everything against the equivalent baseline B lambda_0/lambda so the filters fall on one curve.
The diameter's Fisher information adds over nights; the third panel compares the rotation with spending every night on the best single filter.
